notes: Phone and desktop chats share one encrypted desktop conversation archive. A conversation started on either device can continue on the other when connected.
The phone reconnects to its saved PC after a dropped connection or desktop restart, using the existing paired identity.
A phone web search can request access for one turn. The separate /web on command asks for lasting access until /web off.
The desktop can open an exact Windows Search result and act on named controls or unique visible text after approval.
Optional local Ming Image generation can supply original assets for confirmed website builds.
